name: Plane Crash Simulator
desc:
Version 3.60

New in this update: 

added more destructible objects to the map, such as Ferris wheels, cliffside lighthouses

we made the military base interactive—perhaps flying over the area won’t be such a good idea!

 By popular demand, added new sounds, with the option to enable or disable them.

 we revamped  the mobile UI, making it cleaner and more streamlined.

added a new plane


New code coming at 120K Likes!

Join us so you don’t miss future updates and new codes!

Welcome to Plane Crash Simulator! 

Jump into a crazy world where you can spawn insane aircraft, soar through the skies, and experience epic crashes! 

Create wild and fictional scenarios and enjoy flying like never before!
